I'll explain again: you use dojo and take part in a whirlpool coinjoin along with 5 other people. None of the other 5 use dojo, so they send their xpubs to SamouraiWallet. Then SW can easily unmix the whirlpool because the other 5 addresses are seen by their server but not yours
